subject: [PATCH v4 13/13] mm/collapse: implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch moves the implementation of MADV_COLLAPSE from khugepaged.c to madvise.c, where it belongs among other madvise operations. This change simplifies the code and removes redundant functionality in khugepaged.c. The !CONFIG_TRANSPARENT_HUGEPAGE stub is also moved with it. The MADV_COLLAPSE operation remains a caller of the interface used by khugepaged, so its behavior does not change.
